_comment: Store screenshot copy and styling, in one place because every store reads
it. tool/screenshot_job.dart turns this into a moksha job; moksha renders
the finished images and checks them against each store's upload rules.
Scene ids match the capture names integration_test/screenshot_test.dart
writes. Add a screen there and add it here.
Background is the Refetch purple (#4E1CB3, docs/BRANDING.md); text is
white. Headlines use Poppins (the wordmark's face), subheads Inter, as on
refetch.io. These are store copy, not UI strings: write the benefit.
